headline: US says India tariffs could drop to 17% with deal
hook: A trade pact could slash US duties on Indian products.
what: The U.S. Trade Representative announced that if a trade agreement is reached, the United States will cap the tariff on Indian imports at 17 percent. At present, the U.S. has imposed a 25 percent tariff on India, one of the highest among 14 countries under review.
why: Lower tariffs could make US‑made goods cheaper for Indian buyers and boost Indian exports, affecting prices and job prospects. Keep an eye on trade news as it may influence market trends and career options.

headline: Air India, AI Express to run as one group, two brands
hook: Your next flight might be booked under a new combined brand
what: Air India and its low‑cost arm AI Express will operate under a single corporate group while keeping separate brand identities. The Tata group, which bought Air India from the government, says the move will streamline operations.
why: This could bring more flight choices and possibly lower fares for students traveling within India. Watch for updated ticket prices when you book.

headline: 1Password breach: employee account accessed, passwords remain secure
hook: Your saved passwords are still safe despite the hack.
what: A cyber intruder entered a staff member’s corporate login at 1Password and retrieved some user‑related data. The firm says the incident did not expose the actual vault passwords.
why: Because the core encryption stayed intact, teens can keep using the manager without worry. Strengthen your master password and turn on two‑factor authentication.

headline: Helium Bubbles May Shield Nuclear Fuel
hook: A small helium bubble trick might slow nuclear fuel aging.
what: A US study looked at helium bubbles for advanced nuclear reactors. Simulations suggested the bubbles might help with radioactive material. They could also clean metals from the fuel.
why: It is early US research, so it may not matter immediately to Indian teens. Still, it points to future nuclear power work.

headline: Dulquer Salmaan's 'Aakasamlo Oka Tara' crosses 32 cr worldwide
hook: The Telugu hit keeps pulling crowds even after a week.
what: The film 'Aakasamlo Oka Tara' earned about Rs 32 crore globally, with a domestic net of Rs 19.65 crore by its fifth day. Day six saw continued strong attendance, with audiences praising the performances of Dulquer Salmaan and Satvika Veeravalli.
why: Its success shows regional cinema can draw big numbers, encouraging teens to explore Telugu movies beyond Bollywood. Check it out on streaming platforms if you enjoy fresh stories.

headline: Kerala CM rejects 1:25 teacher-student ratio, orders rank list review
hook: Your future school seats might get re‑checked after this move.
what: The Kerala chief minister said the state will not adopt a 1:25 teacher‑student ratio. She also announced the formation of a panel to examine the Public Service Commission’s rank lists.
why: Students awaiting PSC results may see changes if the panel finds discrepancies. Stay updated on any revisions that could affect admissions or job eligibility.

headline: Meta reps meet Congress over content‑moderation bias claims
hook: Big tech and politicians sit down to discuss what you see online
what: Meta sent Aman Jain and Natasha Jog to a meeting with Congress members. The discussion focused on accusations that the platform’s content‑moderation is biased. Congress leader Supriya Shrinate attended.
why: Content moderation shapes the posts and videos you encounter, so knowing platform policies matters. Keep an eye on any changes that could affect your feed.

headline: India says voluntary return to Bangladesh isn’t an extradition case
hook: A citizen can go back without a legal extradition process, says MEA.
what: The Ministry of External Affairs clarified that a person willing to travel back to Bangladesh on a travel document is dealt with separately from any extradition request. The comment came from spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal.
why: It shows that voluntary travel isn’t linked to legal proceedings, so young Indians should know the distinction if they or someone they know faces a similar situation.

headline: Suryoday Small Finance Bank tops FD rates at 8.25% for 5 years
hook: Grab a high‑interest lock‑in before big banks catch up
what: Suryoday Small Finance Bank is offering an 8.25% interest on five‑year fixed deposits, the highest among banks currently. Small finance banks generally lead the market, with rates also listed for SBI, HDFC and other banks.
why: Higher returns can boost savings for students and young professionals, so compare offers before locking funds.

headline: Air India and Air India Express Get One Group Setup
hook: The two Air India brands aren’t merging, but they’ll now be part of one group.
what: Air India and Air India Express plan to run as a single group while keeping their own brands. Air India is also changing its top deck. The airline’s CEO Tewolde has set a ₹6,000 crore cost-saving target and wants to boost revenue.
why: For young Indians, the two airlines will still be separate brands even as they operate under one group. The CEO set a cost-saving target and plans to boost revenue.

headline: NY bans AI chatbot toys for five years
hook: Your kid's AI gift could be illegal in New York.
what: The state announced a five‑year prohibition on toys that use AI chatbots. Research from Common Sense Media highlighted safety issues such as exposure to inappropriate content and possible harm to emotional development.
why: Teens and parents should avoid buying AI chat toys in NY and stay alert for similar rules elsewhere.

headline: Samsung rolls out One UI 9 Watch update for Galaxy Watch8
hook: Your smartwatch now tracks heart health like never before
what: Samsung has begun the global rollout of the One UI 9 Watch update. The new software adds advanced heart‑health monitoring to the Galaxy Watch8 series and brings Wear OS 7 to older Galaxy Watch models.
why: It gives teens better health insights and fresh features on their wearables, so keep your watch updated.

headline: WhatsApp adds message scheduling for chats
hook: Set your texts to send later, no need to remember
what: The app now lets users choose a future time for a message in both group and one‑on‑one chats. Scheduling can be set from ten minutes up to fourteen days ahead.
why: It helps students and friends plan reminders or birthday wishes without staying online, so they can focus on studies or other tasks.

headline: Supreme Court says child's wishes matter in custody fights
hook: Your voice matters even in family court battles.
what: The Supreme Court emphasized that a child's preferences should be considered when deciding custody. The judgment highlighted that children are not to be treated as objects in parental disputes.
why: Understanding this can empower kids to speak up in family matters. It also reminds families to respect children's opinions during separations.

headline: Ex‑cyber exec charged with cheating ransomware victims
hook: He allegedly took extra money after paying hackers.
what: U.S. prosecutors say a former cyber‑security executive paid ransomware attackers on behalf of victims, then billed them a higher amount and kept the surplus.
why: Such fraud could affect anyone facing ransomware, so staying aware of payment processes is important.

headline: US eyes 25% tariff on Indian goods, talks may ease it
hook: A steep US duty could hit Indian exports, but a deal might cut it.
what: The United States has proposed a 25% tariff on imports from India. India is seeking lower duties than its competitors. Ongoing trade talks could bring the rate down.
why: Higher tariffs may raise prices and affect jobs in export sectors. Staying aware helps you gauge economic impacts on future opportunities.

headline: ITAT clears tax on loan repayment cash deposit
hook: Got cash from a loan? It might not be taxable.
what: A Delhi Income Tax Appellate Tribunal removed a tax addition of ₹12.09 lakh after the taxpayer proved the cash deposited was a repayment of a ₹25 lakh loan. The lender initially denied the loan, but its own balance sheets confirmed the transaction.
why: It shows loan repayments can be defended as non‑income, so keep proper documents. If taxed, you can challenge the demand with proof of the loan.

headline: India clinches Venice Biennale win, PM calls it proud moment
hook: India's art shines on the global stage
what: India secured a win at the Venice Art Biennale. Prime Minister Narendra Modi praised the achievement, calling it a proud moment for the nation.
why: The recognition underscores India's growing cultural influence and can inspire young artists to pursue international platforms.

headline: Govt rolls out ₹11,000‑crore plan to boost construction gear
hook: A massive fund aims to spark local production of high‑tech building machines.
what: The Union Cabinet cleared a scheme worth ₹11,000 crore to promote domestic manufacturing of construction equipment. The plan will give incentives to firms that make technologically advanced machinery in India.
why: It could create jobs and cut reliance on imports, opening opportunities in engineering and manufacturing for youth. Students interested in technical fields may look into related courses or internships.

headline: Supreme Court revokes bail for ex-Karnataka minister in murder case
hook: A top politician loses his freedom after the highest court steps in.
what: Former minister Kulkarni was convicted in April for a 2016 murder. The Karnataka High Court had suspended his life sentence and granted bail so he could remain an MLA during the appeal. The Supreme Court set aside that order, saying bail cannot be given for such serious crimes.
why: The ruling shows that even powerful figures can be held accountable, reinforcing the rule of law for young Indians. Stay aware of judicial decisions that shape politics.

headline: Kerala to overhaul PSC hiring process, panel to audit rank lists
hook: Your future job chances may change as Kerala rechecks PSC selections.
what: The Kerala government announced a review of the Public Service Commission's recruitment procedures. A panel headed by the Chief Secretary will scrutinize the existing rank lists and related processes.
why: This could affect upcoming job exams and selections for youths in the state. Candidates should stay updated on any changes to application guidelines.

headline: Apple Black Friday prices hit record lows
hook: Grab Apple gadgets at steep discounts before the rush.
what: Apple has cut prices on its watches, earbuds, laptops and tablets. A fresh $100 discount on AirPods Pro 3 is part of the offers. The deals appeared ahead of Black Friday.
why: Students can save big on devices for school or entertainment, so check the Apple store now.

headline: KSEB partners with NTPC and NGEL for green energy
hook: Kerala's power board teams up for cleaner electricity
what: The Kerala State Electricity Board has signed an agreement with NTPC Ltd and NGEL. The deal focuses on developing green energy projects in the state.
why: It could boost renewable power supply, creating greener jobs and lower emissions for youth.

headline: Kerala CM’s teacher-student ratio claim called misleading by teachers
hook: The state’s education stats may not be what they seem.
what: The Kerala State Teachers’ Association says the chief minister’s reported teacher‑student ratio is inaccurate. While the ratio has traditionally been calculated per class, the CM presented a figure based on the total number of teachers and students across the state.
why: Accurate ratios affect classroom size and learning quality, which impacts students’ education. Teens should stay informed about how education data is presented and demand clarity.

headline: Todoist data breach exposes user emails and passwords
hook: Your Todoist login info might be at risk
what: A hacker accessed Todoist’s production servers and took user data. Stolen details include email addresses, password hashes and the dates accounts were created.
why: If you use Todoist, change your password and enable two‑factor authentication. Protecting your login info helps keep other accounts safe.

headline: December 2026: New SBI Card Fees and SEBI Rules
hook: Your wallet, Aadhaar and investments get fresh updates.
what: SBI will apply updated charges to its credit cards from December. SEBI has introduced new margin requirements for commodity trading. Overseas investors who qualify can now complete digital KYC more easily.
why: Young adults should check the revised card fees to avoid surprises and understand the new commodity margins if they trade. Updating Aadhaar email before year‑end and meeting pension life‑certificate deadlines can keep services uninterrupted.

headline: Nov 30 deadline for Jeevan Pramaan digital life certificate
hook: Remarried or re‑employed pensioners, you can’t upload online.
what: The Jeevan Pramaan portal stops accepting digital life certificates after Nov 30. Pensioners who are remarried or have taken up new jobs are not eligible to submit the certificate online. They must approach the pension office in person.
why: Missing the deadline could delay pension payments, so affected retirees should visit their local office promptly.

headline: Allstate faces days-long tech outage before Thanksgiving
hook: Travel plans hit as Allstate’s systems go down
what: Allstate’s digital platforms experienced a multi‑day outage. The issue emerged just before the Thanksgiving travel rush, affecting the insurer’s online services.
why: Even if you’re not an Allstate customer, the glitch shows how tech failures can disrupt essential services during busy periods. It’s a reminder to have backup plans when relying on digital tools.

headline: Kerala Sets Up Panel to Review PSC Jobs and Rankings
hook: A new panel could reshape state job selections.
what: The Kerala government has created a committee to examine the Public Service Commission's recruitment procedures, rank lists, and vacant positions. The panel will assess existing processes and decisions.
why: This review may affect upcoming government job exams and postings, so aspirants should stay updated.

headline: Patient missing from Thrissur MCH discovered dead after 36 hrs
hook: A missing hospital patient was found lifeless in a washroom.
what: A patient who went missing from Thrissur Medical College Hospital was located dead in a washroom 36 hours later. The discovery came after a search by authorities.
why: It raises concerns about patient safety and monitoring in hospitals, prompting families to demand better oversight.

headline: MEA says Saurav Das got notice over passport birthplace query
hook: A show‑cause notice may block his UK trip.
what: The Ministry of External Affairs confirmed a notice was sent to Saurav Das because of questions about the birthplace listed in his passport. Das claims the notice was intended to stop his travel to the United Kingdom.
why: Young travelers should double‑check passport details; any mismatch can trigger official scrutiny.

headline: 68-year-old gets lifelong pension despite missing army record
hook: Even if your dad’s name isn’t in the files, you can still claim pension.
what: The Armed Forces Tribunal ordered a lifelong family pension for a 68-year-old disabled man. It ruled that his father’s absence from army service records does not block the claim. The centre must also pay pending pension with 6% annual interest.
why: It shows bureaucratic gaps don’t automatically deny benefits, so families should verify entitlement and file claims if needed.

headline: Amazon, Meta negotiate to end Muse AI block
hook: Your favorite AI buddy might be back soon.
what: Amazon and Meta are in talks to lift the restrictions on the AI assistant Muse. The blockage has lasted around two months.
why: If the talks succeed, users will regain access to Muse’s features, affecting how they use AI tools.

headline: Cabinet approves ₹2,014 cr new Silchar airport
hook: A fresh airport plan could reshape travel for Assam’s youth.
what: The government cabinet gave the green light to build a new airport in Silchar, with a budget of ₹2,014 crore. The current Silchar airfield, run by the Air Force and AAI, covers a 70‑acre civil enclave.
why: A modern airport may offer better connectivity for students and job seekers in the region. Keep an eye on travel updates if you plan trips or internships nearby.

headline: Comedian Yash Maheshwari booked in Patna over Chhath comments
hook: A joke about women at a sacred festival landed him in police custody.
what: Comedian Yash Maheshwari was arrested in Patna after his remarks about women observing the Chhath festival drew police action. Authorities booked him under relevant sections.
why: The incident highlights sensitivity around religious practices; young people should be mindful of cultural sentiments when expressing opinions.

headline: Kerala to overhaul PSC recruitment process
hook: A new panel will check rank lists for fairness.
what: The state government announced a review of the Public Service Commission's hiring system. A panel headed by the Chief Secretary will examine the existing rank lists. The move aims to address concerns about the recruitment process.
why: Young job seekers in Kerala could see changes in how civil service jobs are allocated. Stay updated for any new application guidelines.

headline: Microsoft triggers emergency mode after massive Outlook crash
hook: Your inbox went dark and Microsoft is in full‑scale crisis mode.
what: Microsoft announced an internal emergency called “Code Red” after a worldwide outage knocked Outlook offline. The memo said engineers are on high alert following the disruption that the CEO had recently apologized for.
why: Students and young professionals who use Outlook for school or work may face missed messages, so keep an eye on alternative email apps until the service is fully restored.

headline: Supreme Court annuls UP pension exclusion laws
hook: Your future retirement benefits just got protected.
what: The top court declared two Uttar Pradesh statutes invalid because they barred pension credit for service before regularisation. The ruling ensures that employees who become regular cannot lose retirement pay due to their original appointment type.
why: Young workers can now be confident that early job periods will count toward pension, so keep records of all employment dates.

headline: HMD Rise 4G Expected Soon, May Rebrand as Arc 2
hook: A new 4G phone could hit Indian shelves with a fresh name.
what: HMD is reportedly preparing to launch its Rise 4G smartphone in India. The device may be sold under the new name HMD Arc 2 and is said to feature a 5‑megapixel front‑camera.
why: For Gen Z, a 4G phone with a decent front camera can help with social media and online learning. Watch for official updates.

headline: ITAT wipes ₹20.94 L penalty for senior property seller
hook: A senior gets tax relief after proving a cash deal was justified.
what: The Hyderabad Income Tax Appellate Tribunal removed a penalty of about ₹20.94 lakh that had been imposed on an elderly taxpayer over a property sale. The tribunal said the taxpayer had provided reasonable cause for the transaction. The penalty was therefore cancelled.
why: Young people should note that tax authorities can reconsider penalties if valid explanations are given, so keeping proper records and communicating reasons can help avoid hefty fines.
